patterns.pattern: سَ + [Verb] + إِلَى + الـ[Place] + غَدًا، وَ + [يستطيع form] + أَنْ + [Verb]
patterns.exampleArabic: سأذهب إلى المطار غدا وأستطيع أن أسافر
patterns.exampleTransliteration: sa-adhhabu ilā l-maṭāri ghadan wa-astaṭīʿu an usāfira
patterns.exampleEnglish: Tomorrow I will go to the airport, and I am able to travel.
patterns.grammarNote: A closing capstone for levels 41-50: the سَـ future (level 41) joined by وَ (level 20) to أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ + a reused present-tense verb (level 48), reusing المطار and أسافر from levels 43. Halfway to 100 — 50 of 100 levels down. قَلِيلًا ('a little/a few') takes the same -ًا accusative-adverb ending you've now seen on غَدًا, أَمْسًا-type words, and جِدًّا — it can soften an adjective (بَارِدٌ قَلِيلًا, 'a little cold') or modify a verb.
